key.name: backend
key.description: The service used to translate text.

key.name: libre-instance
key.description: Address of the LibreTranslate server. Its API key is kept in the keyring.

key.name: live
key.description: Translate while typing instead of waiting for Ctrl+Enter or Translate.

key.name: fallback
key.description: Send short texts to MyMemory when the chosen service is down or busy.

key.name: keep-history
key.description: Remember recent translations on this computer.

key.name: source
key.description: Language code of the text to translate, or auto to detect it.

key.name: target
key.description: Language code of the translation; empty picks one from the system language.
